decisions.reason: Outpatient sociotherapy draws directly on the firm's psychiatric and multidisciplinary expertise, so the firm can interpret its results and improve it, and its move to the home page in 2024 signals growing commitment.
Counseling on senior living builds on core eldercare knowledge and has stayed on the home page in both years, showing it is well absorbed into the established offer.
The retail shop uses the sheltered workshop's existing production know-how and was promoted to the home page in 2024, even though the related carpentry offer was dropped.

Meal delivery fits the firm's everyday-life assistance for seniors, but it is new and only mentioned on the website, so the firm needs another year of results before judging it, and keeping it is the sensible default.
